releaseNotes: Production Release v1.1.0 of JNSD Education Centre School ERP.
Official School Crest integrated across Navbar, Login, Receipts, and CBSE Report Cards.
Manager Sir (Lalitesh Kumar Dixit) and Principal (Ram Jiyawan Yadav) two-tier fee approval workflow.
Interactive Fee Calculator & Estimator with custom concession policies and parent quotation sharing.
Class-wise Fee Structure Management for Tuition, Admission, Annual, Computer, and Sports fees.
Student admission wizard with Aadhaar and Birth Certificate OCR verification.
Daily class attendance registers with low attendance alert triggers (<75%).
CBSE 8-point grading examinations ledger with printable Progress Report Cards.
Receipt OCR reconciliation with automated ledger verification.
Ministry of Education UDISE+ validation rules engine and JSON/CSV exports.
